presets.name: Observe everything
presets.description: Check every answer and record what would have happened, without changing any response.

presets.name: Flag risky answers
presets.description: Deliver every answer and tell your app which ones look risky, through X-TrustAgent-* response headers.

presets.name: Block contradictions
presets.description: Block answers that your documents contradict or do not support, when two signals agree. Streams are buffered so a block can replace the answer.

presets.name: Support bot
presets.description: Flag answers that your documents contradict or do not support, and promises of refunds, prices, credits or dates that your policy does not allow. Brand tone is watched in the background and never affects an answer.
presets.ui_note: Fill in Allowed commitments and Brand voice for your product

presets.name: Rubric checks (no documents)
presets.description: For apps that send no documents: flag refusals, unsafe or rule-breaking answers, leaked personal data or secrets, and answers that obey instructions smuggled into the conversation.

presets.name: Replace unverified answers
presets.description: For payments and policy answers, keeping the route's checks: when two signals agree that an answer is contradicted or unsupported, or it links or cites something your documents do not contain, answer again from your documents only, and block if that fails too. End users cannot supply documents.
presets.ui_note: Starts as Flag until calibrated; blocks whenever the check cannot run
